description: Weekly minor and patch updates, merged once the CI passes; majors, ory/hydra-client-go, cosign and Trivy in pull requests of their own, reviewed.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates and new digests, grouped each week, merged once the CI passes (tests, govulncheck).
The Go toolchain of go.mod and the golang image of the Dockerfile move together: the image sets GOTOOLCHAIN=local.
A major version: a pull request of its own, reviewed.
ory/hydra-client-go follows the version of Hydra the app is played against: a pull request of its own, reviewed.
cosign of the release workflow and Trivy of the test workflow: their two checksums come by hand from the release's checksums file; the workflow stops on a wrong one: reviewed.

customManagers.description: cosign and Trivy of the workflows, a version a comment names.
